name: Koschei the Deathless

crownPassive.name: Thief of treasures
crownPassive.text: Your opponent's items cost 1 action point instead of being free.

bond.name: Rus' kin
bond.text: +1 health for each other Rus' hero you field.

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Whirlwind
actions.text: Deal 3 to an enemy hero and swap it with a card next to it.

rules: Always on, in any slot: while your Needle lives, Koschei can't drop below 1 health.
Whenever you field Koschei, the Needle is placed in slot 6 automatically and costs no Renown.
Nightfall damage ignores the hidden death.
